dedupe_resolutions.notes: Vance's end-times statement was made in a broad faith interview and did not explicitly concern Iran or any particular official act. It remains a distinct governance and risk-framing statement rather than being merged into the Iran/Hormuz war record.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

The shared White House fact sheet reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One record concerns announced company agreements; the other concerns an administration-reported program measurement.

rejected_candidates.title: Missouri Supreme Court blocks state congressional map pending referendum
rejected_candidates.reason: The unanimous ruling is consequential and Trump-backed Republicans drew the map, but the operative conduct is state redistricting and state-court review rather than a federal administration action. Trump's criticism and reposts do not independently bring it within the National Trump Record's federal scope.

rejected_candidates.title: Repeated Triumphal Arch excavation coverage
rejected_candidates.reason: The new Reuters report repeated the already-recorded announcement that excavation would begin within two weeks and added no contract, appropriation, completed work or court ruling. The existing record remains current.

rejected_candidates.title: Trump proposal that Europe repay United States for Ukraine support
rejected_candidates.reason: The statement identified no agreement, introduced legislation, appropriation, invoice, executive instrument or foreign commitment and therefore remained a prospective and unsupported policy demand.

rejected_candidates.title: Reported request to remove a Pennsylvania measles death from CDC tally
rejected_candidates.reason: The consequential causal claim depended primarily on unnamed sources and lacked confirmation from a second independent outlet or a public directive by cutoff. The dispute remains a research lead rather than a canonical finding.

rejected_candidates.title: Truth Social commentary, reposts and personal praise
rejected_candidates.reason: Seven of eight new posts were criticism of a state-court ruling, duplicate reposts, image-only material, old or opinion links, and personal praise. They establish only what Trump published and did not independently document another qualifying federal action.

rejected_candidates.title: Routine notices, campaign activity and duplicate coverage
rejected_candidates.reason: No post-boundary Federal Register filing was identified, and routine personnel chatter, campaign material and repeated accounts of already-recorded actions did not clear the materiality or lifecycle thresholds.

rejected_candidates.title: External archive discovery leads
rejected_candidates.reason: Unit-specific external measurements remain separate discovery inputs and contribute zero canonical entries by default. No upstream item advanced without original-source inspection and full Record review.

corrections.summary: Corrected NAT-2026-09-02-012 after the Pentagon removed and temporarily rescinded its September 2 testosterone-screening clinical guidance on September 3. The archive no longer describes those detailed pathways as operative; it preserves that the broader July mandate and interim guidance remain.

Added the FCC-ABC early-license-review lifecycle after the government's September 3 dismissal filing and added the Fannie-Freddie VantageScore directive disclosed just before the prior boundary but independently reported afterward. Both retain their actual chronology rather than being presented as wholly post-boundary actions.
